plugins.name: claude-annotate
plugins.description: Read Claude's long answers in a browser and comment on any block; Claude rewrites that block in place. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (standard library only, nothing to install).

plugins.name: claude-ide-review
plugins.description: Ask Claude questions on a PR diff line, a local diff line, or a code walkthrough step, inside IntelliJ or VS Code. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH and either the companion IntelliJ plugin or the vscode-plugin extension. VS Code's per-line diff comments also need the separately-installed webcompanion daemon (run /annotate-doctor to check or install it); diffs still open without it.
